notes.title: Mac Version Just Around the Corner!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

We released a build of Rift's Cave for Linux a while time ago and now we're happy to announce a Mac version is also coming!

We have almost finished testing and finalizing optimization.

It's great to be one of the few publishers with Oculus Rift games that support all three different operating systems!

We are also working on the next version (2.8) that will be available very soon! Our first goal is to solve all the current knows bugs and in the same time start to re-create some character dialogue and voice acting since a lot of people have said that some recordings weren't so good.

I hope that our new voice recordings will be better for you all!

Thanks! 

Andrea Marinelli
CEO Frost Earth Studio

notes.title: Rift's Cave Update (05/12/14)
notes.notes:
Rift's Cave has now been updated to RC_Alpha v2.2 

Changelog: 

- New Oculus SDK (0.4.4)
- Updated from Unity 4.5.5 to Unity 4.6.0
- Removed the Dialog box between levels if the Oculus mode is Extended       Mode.
- Added some missing audiotracks
- Small other fixes

If you wish to report a bug, please visit here.
